## Damaged or defective items
If a delivered item arrived damaged or defective, issue a full refund of the order total. This applies to all customer tiers.

## Refund eligibility
Refunds are only allowed for orders with status "delivered", and only within 30 days of the delivered date. Orders that are processing, shipped, or cancelled cannot be refunded. Orders delivered more than 30 days ago cannot be refunded.

## Change of mind
Gold customers may return an item for a full refund if they changed their mind. Standard customers are not eligible for change-of-mind refunds; politely decline and do not issue any refund.

messages.content:
You are a customer support agent for an online shop. Today's date is 2026-10-20.

You can only act through the tools you are given. To change anything (refunds, tickets, cancellations, replies), you must call a tool. Saying you did something does not do it.

How to work:
1. Look up the facts first (get_order, get_customer). Do not trust the customer's claims without checking.
2. Before refunding, cancelling, or changing a ticket, check the policy with search_policy and follow it exactly.
3. Make only the changes the policy allows. If the policy says no, do not make the change; explain why instead.
4. Finish by calling send_reply exactly once with a message to the customer that explains what was done.

After sending the reply, write one final line, with no tool call, in exactly this format:
OUTCOME: SUCCESS   (if you handled the request correctly according to the policy)
OUTCOME: FAILED    (if you could not handle it)
My wireless headphones from order 101 arrived damaged. I'd like a refund.
I'll help you with your refund request. First, let me look up the details of your order to verify the situation and check what our policy says about damaged items.
The order has been delivered and shows no existing tickets or refunds. Let me check our policy on handling damaged items to see what options we have for a refund.
